purpose: Ingest authoritative cross-domain sources surfaced by raw states 99396, 99936 and 39599, emphasizing biological asset custody, firmware security maintenance, stormwater/civil terminology and enterprise security-enforcement failures.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Regional Lenovo support mirrors, duplicate NVD records and alternate biological-catalog pages for the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Catalogue IDs, PSIRT identifiers, CVE numbers, standard numbers, job codes and page numbers may be operationally useful but are not Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: Lenovo XClarity Controller firmware releases addressing LEN-99936
sources.note: Use as a firmware-security lifecycle reference: XCC/BMC release notes explicitly mark LEN-99936 as a PSIRT/security fix and document firmware/UEFI update sequencing. 99936 is the PSIRT identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2024-39599 — SAP NetWeaver malware scanner API bypass
sources.note: Use as a control-enforcement failure case: configured malware-scanning protection can be bypassed through application logic. 39599 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: GB/T 39599-2020 — Low impact development stormwater management and harvest—Basic terminology
sources.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation / Standardization Administration of China
sources.note: Current national standard. Use to normalize terminology for low-impact-development stormwater management/harvesting within future civil/environmental modeling. 39599 is the standard number.

sources.title: ATCC 99396 — human YAC clone yWXD6466 [I164A2]
sources.note: Use custody, contamination, storage, biosafety and licensing metadata as a governed biological-research-asset reference. 99396 is a catalogue identifier.

sources.title: Addgene plasmid 99936 — pcDNA3-HA-REDD1 N179-193
sources.note: Use distribution eligibility, sequence/map metadata and material-transfer constraints as a research-asset governance pattern. 99936 is the plasmid catalogue identifier.

information_updates.finding: Worldshepherd infrastructure inventory should distinguish firmware/BMC/UEFI security lineage from OS/application dependency lineage, because management-controller fixes can require ordered updates and reboots outside ordinary package management.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Derived from Lenovo's firmware-maintenance pattern; it does not imply the user's current hardware is affected.

information_updates.finding: CVE-2024-39599 reinforces a governance distinction between security-control presence and security-control effectiveness: configured malware scanning is insufficient if executable code paths can bypass the enforcement hook.

ATCC/Addgene records show a reusable research-asset schema: identity, provenance/depositor, storage/handling, contamination/quality status, legal-use constraints, sequence/material metadata and distribution eligibility.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Catalogue IDs are not Glob evidence.
